heading: Monitoring of compliance

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Director, through binding contractual agreements with owners or other authorized entities, shall ensure long-term compliance with the provisions of this subchapter.

children.heading: Measures
children.text: The measures referred to in paragraph (1) shall provide for—
to the extent allowable by Federal and State law, the enforcement of the provisions of this subchapter by the Department and the Secretary; and
remedies for breach of the provisions referred to in paragraph (1).

children.heading: In general
children.text: Not less frequently than annually, the Director shall review the activities conducted and housing assisted under this subchapter to assess compliance with the requirements of this subchapter.

children.heading: Review
children.text: Each review under paragraph (1) shall include onsite inspection of housing to determine compliance with applicable requirements.

children.heading: Results
children.text: The results of each review under paragraph (1) shall be—
included in a performance report of the Director submitted to the Secretary under section 4239 of this title; and

tree.heading: Performance measures
tree.text: The Secretary shall establish such performance measures as may be necessary to assess compliance with the requirements of this subchapter.
